always_available.summary: travel to a named site, or set a heading to a coordinate
rest until a condition or deadline

queue.note: at most 8 pending actions per agent; submit once the queue drains (the 429 response carries Retry-After: 2)

staleness.note: observed_seq older than 600 ticks behind the live seq → re-observe (GET observations or the join snapshot) and resubmit with the fresh seq

sleep_shape.summary: rest until a condition or the timer — a bounded rest, never a shutdown (to leave the world, DELETE /worlds/lysvik/agents/:id/session)

max_sleep_ticks.note: world ticks (1 tick = 500 ms — the ceiling is 200 real seconds); ALWAYS required — conditions accelerate a wake, the timer bounds it

wake_conditions.note: up to 8 conditions, OR across them, clauses AND within one; compiled at registration — a bad grammar refuses at the door with a named reason

semantics.board_fields: EDGE-TRIGGERED: a board condition fires when work APPEARS (its predicate crosses false→true), never on standing truth — sleeping while work already stands open does not wake you; tick conditions are level (your own alarm); event conditions are instants
semantics.wake_cooldown_note: after a condition-wake, your next condition-wake arms only after 240 ticks (120 real seconds) — the timer path is exempt; rest is bounded, never stolen
semantics.completion: no action_id and no action_applied: the receipts are the typed events agent_slept (wake_at_tick, wake_condition_count) and agent_woke (by: "timer" | "condition", slept_ticks) in your digest
